definitions.explanation: The standard of something when compared to other things.

examples.japanese: この{製品|せいひん}は{質|しつ}が{良|い}い。
examples.english: This product is of good quality.

examples.japanese: {量|りょう}より{質|しつ}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Quality is more important than quantity.

examples.japanese: {値段|ねだん}は{安|やす}いが、{質|しつ}が{悪|わる}いので{買|か}わない{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: The price is cheap, but the quality is poor, so you shouldn't buy it.

notes:
{質|しつ} refers to quality, nature, or character of something.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {質|しつ}が{良|い}い/{高|たか}い: good/high quality
- {質|しつ}が{悪|わる}い/{低|ひく}い: poor/low quality
- {質|しつ}を{上|あ}げる: to improve quality
- {質|しつ}を{保|たも}つ: to maintain quality

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {品質|ひんしつ}: product quality
- {性質|せいしつ}: nature, character
- {体質|たいしつ}: constitution, physique
- {質問|しつもん}: question

CONTRAST:
- {量|りょう}より{質|しつ}: quality over quantity
- {質|しつ}より{量|りょう}: quantity over quality
